channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terrance Ferguson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terrance Ferguson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danilo Gallinari on Dennis Schroeder, Terrance Ferguson, James Harden, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Danilo Gallinari on guarding James Harden if Lu Dort misses time:

“We have great 1 on 1 defenders with Hami, Terrance, Andre and Dennis. But it will be a team effort.”

Danilo Gallinari on Dennis Schroeder, Terrance Ferguson, James Harden, Luguentz Dort, Aug 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Terrance Ferguson
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Donovan on the young guys:

“You can tell Ferguson, Bailey, Hami look stronger... ...and even Dort looks stronger if you can believe that.”

Billy Donovan on Terrance Ferguson, Jul 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Paul George on Terrance Ferguson
item.description:
Very interesting from Paul George on the next steps for Terrance Ferguson:

“Ferg has to put pressure on Coach now to use him more in the offense. That’s what you want from the young guys. This is a pivotal year for young guys and he’s gotta make a jump for us.”

Paul George on Terrance Ferguson, Apr 25, 2019. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Terrance Ferguson
item.description:
Maddie Lee:Billy Donovan on Terrance Ferguson:

“Terrance has always has an incredibly open mindabout improvement, growth and development.”

Billy Donovan on Terrance Ferguson, Jan 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @maddie_m_lee.
